scenario.recruiter: time-constrained independent recruiter managing sensitive candidate evidence across repeated conversations
scenario.trigger: A source was authorized for a bounded period, already informed a confirmed person fact and Wiki, then reached its deadline while the recruiter was away.
scenario.job_to_be_done: Prevent stale permission from silently remaining in Chat or the person page, understand what was withdrawn, and renew without resurrecting old conclusions.
scenario.success_condition: The deadline is enforced at every use, the durable system transition retracts derivatives and recompiles, renewal returns evidence to review, and a second account learns nothing.
scenario.pressure_limit: This review covers local product integrity, not production operations, legal advice, adoption, or willingness to pay.

strengths: The recruiter sees one source as expired in the same ledger used for evidence review, not in a separate compliance dashboard.
Expired, revoked, deleted, and still-processing sources remain distinct.
A renewal reason and optional new deadline fit the source-level decision and keep the page compact.
The relationship remains usable because the Wiki recompiles from other authorized evidence.
Renewal never recreates yesterday's fact or task; it creates a bounded review queue.

findings.observation: The elapsed state is clear after the recruiter opens the relationship, but there is no quiet pre-expiry Today item for a source likely to matter before a call.
findings.user_impact: The system is safe, while the recruiter may discover lost context only during preparation.
findings.recommendation: Test one low-noise pre-expiry attention item keyed to an active search or upcoming recruiter-owned event, with snooze and no automatic outreach.
findings.verification: Working recruiters notice important upcoming expiries without dismissing the feed as compliance noise.

findings.observation: No working recruiter has yet compared renewal and recovery with their ATS, notes, or manual memory.
findings.user_impact: Integrity is proven, while event frequency, perceived value, and willingness to pay remain unknown.
findings.recommendation: Include bounded-permission and candidate-withdrawal cases in the concierge field comparison.
findings.verification: Measure recovery time, trust, correction burden, and repeated use across consented real workflows.

reviews.lens: authorization, provenance, privacy, derived-state integrity, and reversibility
strengths: Evidence authorization has an independent deadline rather than borrowing the raw file retention deadline.
Use-time checks prevent the scheduler interval from becoming an authorization grace period.
Automatic expiry is system-attributed and renewal is human-attributed.
Confirmed state, claims, unexecuted actions, approvals, Wiki snapshots, Chat contexts, research entry, and identity-handle matching respect the elapsed boundary.
The replacement Wiki contains no dependency on the elapsed source.
Renewal moves evidence and claims to review without restoring state or execution authority.
A live second account was denied the resource.
The authorization decision and recompilation job now commit atomically; a restarted worker reclaimed an expired lease and the next restart performed no duplicate work.
A completed verified effect remained recorded while expiry removed future authority and produced a recruiter follow-up warning in Agent history and Web completion copy.
A mixed completed-and-unknown case returned two exact action records, ranked the unresolved result first, preserved the completed observation, and invented no observation for the timeout.

findings.observation: The populated two-effect review has now passed direct desktop and 390-pixel responsive inspection, including unresolved-first ordering, long destination keys, exact-section navigation, expanded Chat history, and light and dark modes. Native accessibility and working-recruiter comprehension remain untested.
findings.user_impact: The Web presentation no longer hides the distinction, while real-device access and terminology under recruiter pressure remain uncertain.
findings.recommendation: Run the same completed-plus-unknown case on the smallest supported iPhone and with working independent recruiters.
findings.verification: With VoiceOver or large text and without coaching, a recruiter identifies the unresolved effect, avoids repeating the completed effect, and names the correct next check.

adjudication.resolved_prior_finding: Authorization expiry now has an independent clock, use-time enforcement, a system-attributed durable transition, transactional recompilation job, restart-safe lease recovery, derived-state retraction, review-only renewal, live cross-account denial, and a truthful nonzero completed-effect warning.
adjudication.release_boundary: This does not pass the whole multichannel product or a production release. Native accessibility, managed operational alerting, field comparison, and commercial evidence remain open.
adjudication.next_highest_risk_test: Put the populated mixed-effect review in front of working recruiters and observe whether they distinguish completed, unknown, and the required human response without coaching.
